english.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
english.objective: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
english.detail:
If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave.  So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues. 

First ye need to find me footlocker.  It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck.  There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast.  Find that anchor and you'll find me locker!  Look in there for the next clue.
english.complete: The footlocker slowly creaks open. Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait! A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!

english.title: The New Horde
english.detail:
Throm'ka, <Class>. I am Eitrigg, charged by Thrall to oversee the training of recruits.

The Horde has changed from what it once was. There was a time where I left the Horde, disillusioned by the growing influence of the power-hungry pawns of the Burning Legion. During my exile, I was taken prisoner by a group of humans, but was rescued by the Warchief. Hearing his vision of the Horde free of demonic influence, guided by the shamans, I returned.

Gornek will have further instructions for you.
english.complete:
Another one of Eitrigg's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce.  No matter.  By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.

english.objective: Report to Gornek in the Den.

english.title: Your Place in the World
english.objective: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.
english.detail:
Finally, you are of age, <Name>... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

Yes...

<Kaltunk looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young <Class>. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
english.progress: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined <class> will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.

english.title: Excavation Tools
english.objective: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
english.detail: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.

english.title: Excavation Tools
english.objective: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
english.progress: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
english.complete:
Our tools!

When the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
english.detail: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.

english.title: Sticks and Bones
english.objective: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
english.detail:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

english.title: Sticks and Bones
english.objective: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
english.progress: Welcome to my fire, traveler.
english.complete:
Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.

english.title: Soft Saber Pelts
english.objective: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
english.detail:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.

english.title: Soft Saber Pelts
english.objective: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
english.progress: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
english.complete:
Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.

Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.

english.title: Holy Diver
english.objective: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
english.detail:
I have received word back from Darnassus, <Name>!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!

english.title: Holy Diver
english.objective: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
english.progress: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
english.complete:
This has been a long journey, <name>, but it was worth it.

At long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.

Thank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.

english.title: Rediscovering the Light
english.objective: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
english.detail:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.

english.title: Rediscovering the Light
english.objective: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
english.progress: Mastery of the light will return, in time.
english.complete:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, <class>.

english.title: Coming to Terms
english.objective: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
english.detail:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

english.title: Coming to Terms
english.objective: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
english.progress: Coming to terms with this new life is not easy for any of us. For some it's simply more than they can bear.
english.complete:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, <name>.

english.title: Continue Your Training
english.objective: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
english.detail:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

english.title: Continue Your Training
english.objective: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
english.complete:
Welcome aboard, <class>. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, <class>.

english.title: A Second Home
english.objective: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
english.detail:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.

english.title: A Second Home
english.objective: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
english.complete: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, brother.

english.title: Murlocs at the Gates
english.objective: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
english.detail:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

english.title: Murlocs at the Gates
english.objective: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
english.progress: These murlocs just don't quit!
english.complete: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

english.title: Touring the Grounds
english.objective: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
english.detail:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, <Name>. May the light be your guide.

english.title: Touring the Grounds
english.objective: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
english.progress: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, <class>. It's always good to see a new face.
english.complete:
Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.

My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.

There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.

english.title: Making Repairs
english.objective: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
english.detail:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.

english.title: Making Repairs
english.objective: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
english.progress: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, it's turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
english.complete: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.

english.title: The Tarnished
english.objective: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
english.progress: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
english.complete:
Excellent work, <name>. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.

I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
english.detail:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.

english.title: Delicate Instruments
english.objective: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
english.detail:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

english.title: Delicate Instruments
english.objective: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
english.progress: Let me know when you are finished, so I can try to calibrate my instruments again.
english.complete: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...

english.title: Delicate Instruments
english.objective: Kill 8 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
english.detail:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, <Name>. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?

english.objective: Kill 8 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
english.progress: Let me know when you are finished, so I can try to calibrate my instruments again.
english.complete: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, <name>.

english.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
english.objective: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
english.detail:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?

english.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
english.objective: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
english.progress: Did you find the supplies?
english.complete: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!

english.title: Good Steel
english.objective: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
english.detail: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

english.title: Good Steel
english.objective: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
english.progress: Have you been to the mine yet?
english.complete: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.

english.title: Downstream
english.objective: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
english.detail:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?

english.title: Downstream
english.objective: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
english.progress: Did you find the supplies?
english.complete: You look a bit damp, <name>. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.

english.title: Applejack Still
english.detail: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.

english.title: Applejack Still
english.progress: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
english.complete: The machine dispenses a clear liquid into a bottle...

english.title: An Apple Treat
english.detail: The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...

english.title: An Apple Treat
english.progress: The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...
english.complete:
Do my eyes deceive me? I haven't seen a drop of Thunder Applejack in months!
This should put a smile on the troops' faces. You have my thanks, <class>!

english.title: Croaky's Head
english.objective: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, <class>. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
english.detail: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.

english.title: Nibbled-On Book
english.objective: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
english.detail:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>

english.title: Nibbled-On Book
english.objective: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
english.progress: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
english.complete:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
english.detail:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>

english.title: Rascally Rodents
english.objective: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
english.detail: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

english.title: Rascally Rodents
english.objective: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
english.progress: Have you rescued my books yet, <name>?!
english.complete:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
english.detail: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

english.title: Mining Consultant
english.objective: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
english.detail: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

english.title: Mining Consultant
english.objective: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
english.complete: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
english.detail: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

english.title: Elmpaw's Head
english.objective: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
english.detail: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.

english.title: Elmpaw's Head
english.objective: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete:
So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, <name>!

Let me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.
english.detail: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.

english.title: Rough Wolf Pelts
english.objective: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
english.detail: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.

english.title: Rough Wolf Pelts
english.objective: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
english.progress: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
english.complete: Excellent work collecting these pelts, <class>. You have a real talent for hunting.
english.detail: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.

english.title: The Big Picture
english.objective: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
english.detail:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.

english.title: The Big Picture
english.objective: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
english.progress: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
english.complete:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, <name>. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!

english.title: An Enchanting Lesson
english.objective:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
english.detail:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
english.progress: What have your studies revealed?
english.complete: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, <name>. Remember this.

english.title: Follow That Kobold!
english.objective: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
english.complete: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
english.detail:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

english.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
english.objective: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
english.detail:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

english.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
english.objective: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
english.progress: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
english.complete:
What's this, <name>? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
english.detail:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

english.title: Book Return
english.objective: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
english.detail:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!

english.title: Book Return
english.objective: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
english.progress: Have you found all the books yet?
english.complete:
I applaud your diligence, <name>. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.

You can keep that book bag!

english.title: Rare Books
english.objective: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
english.detail:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.

english.title: Rare Books
english.objective: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
english.progress: Have you found all my missing books yet?
english.complete: Oh, <name>! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.

english.title: Wild Eyes
english.objective: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.

english.title: Wild Eyes
english.objective: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Oh. You're back?
english.complete:
The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.

english.title: Return to Quinn (Again)
english.objective: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.

english.title: Return to Quinn (Again)
english.objective: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
english.progress: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
english.complete:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, <name>.
english.detail:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.

english.title: My First Alchemy Set
english.objective: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.detail:
Erm... 'Ello, mister/miss. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?

english.title: My First Alchemy Set
english.objective: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.progress: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
english.complete:
Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?

Wow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?

english.title: My First Real Potion
english.objective: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.detail:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.

english.title: My First Real Potion
english.objective: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.progress: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
english.complete:
You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe!

I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.

<The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>

Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!

english.title: Book Inventory
english.objective: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
english.detail:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

english.title: Book Inventory
english.objective: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
english.complete:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.

english.title: Infestation Investigation
english.objective: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.

english.title: Infestation Investigation
english.objective: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.
english.complete: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
english.detail:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.

english.title: The Cirrusfly Queen
english.objective: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.

english.title: The Cirrusfly Queen
english.objective: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!
english.complete: Excellent work, <name>. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
english.detail:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
english.progress: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.
english.complete: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, <name>.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
english.detail:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass northeast of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need see.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
english.complete:
Ah... <name>... child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds.

I can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <Name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: As you will come to learn, the path we walk is not as simple as it may seem. While we seek to find the voice needed to speak with the spirits of the winds, the winds are but one of the elemental forces of this world. Only through understanding, and--we hope--mastery of all four elements will we regain our voice to again sing the songs of the wind.
english.complete:
Good!

The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among <class>--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.

The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.

But for now, take this earth totem...

english.title: Falling With Style
english.objective: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
english.detail:
Well hello there, <Name>! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!

english.title: Falling With Style
english.objective: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
english.progress: Using your ability to walk on air can get you out of--and, well... into--all kinds of trouble!
english.complete:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.

english.title: A Scribbled Letter
english.objective: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
english.detail: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <Name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

english.title: A Scribbled Letter
english.objective: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
english.progress:
Ah, ye got me letter, <name>... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a <race> dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
english.complete:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled <class> can give 'em. Good luck.
english.detail: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

english.title: A Student of the Arcane
english.objective: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
english.detail: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.

english.title: A Student of the Arcane
english.objective: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: Greetings, <name>. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
english.complete:
Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young <class>. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
english.detail: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.

english.title: The Way of the Hunter
english.objective: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
english.detail: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.

english.title: The Way of the Hunter
english.objective: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: <Tai'ree nods at you curtly.>
english.complete:
The way of the <class> is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
english.detail: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.

english.title: At Home in the Shadows
english.objective: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.

english.title: At Home in the Shadows
english.objective: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: <Akeri eyes you suspiciously.>
english.complete:
I almost did not hear you approach me, young <class>.

Almost.

Almost won't be good enough when you leave Thendal Grove. You must be a slender blade, silent and steady. Ever vigilant and ever mindful of your surroundings. You might have what it takes to survive the dangers of Zephras. You also might end up with your throat slit in a ditch. Ultimately that's entirely up to you.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
english.detail:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.

english.title: Embracing the Elements
english.objective: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: Winds guide you, <name>.
english.complete:
Can you hear it? The whispers of the winds? Doubtful, considering that the spirits stopped speaking with us when they left us those years ago. 

Those among us who would seek audience with the spirits of the four winds once more hone our understanding of the elements and the natural world, dearly hoping to reestablish the dialogue that was so abruptly ended. 

Would you walk this path and master the elements?

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps and I will train you.
english.detail: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.

english.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
english.objective: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
english.detail:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

english.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
english.objective: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
english.complete:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.
english.detail:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

english.title: The Criminal Element
english.objective: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

english.title: The Criminal Element
english.objective: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.complete:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

english.title: Among the Faithful
english.objective: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.

english.title: Among the Faithful
english.objective: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: What did you learn?
english.complete:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.

english.title: Falaath Village
english.objective:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.
english.complete:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
english.detail:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

english.title: The Warrior's Path
english.objective: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
english.detail:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.

english.title: The Warrior's Path
english.objective: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
english.progress: So you've come for training, then?
english.complete:
You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.

Good luck, <name>, may the winds guide you.
english.detail:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.

english.title: Havoc in the Highlands
english.objective: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
english.detail:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

english.title: Havoc in the Highlands
english.objective: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
english.progress: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
english.complete:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, <name>.
english.detail:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.

english.title: Stolen Supplies
english.objective: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.

english.title: Stolen Supplies
english.objective: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.
english.complete: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.

english.title: Restocking the Larders
english.objective: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

english.title: Restocking the Larders
english.objective: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!
english.complete:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.
english.detail:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

english.title: To Valanaar
english.objective: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.detail:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <Name>.

english.title: To Valanaar
english.objective: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.progress: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
english.complete:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.

english.title: The Windshapers
english.objective: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
english.detail:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

english.title: The Windshapers
english.objective: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
english.progress: The world is changing and the path forward will be difficult. We have but one chance to save ourselves.
english.complete:
I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

english.title: The High Order
english.objective: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
english.progress: Our land is going through changes, but there may yet be some good to come of this.
english.complete:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
english.detail:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

english.title: The Gift of Skysight
english.objective: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

english.title: The Gift of Skysight
english.objective: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
english.complete:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

english.title: Desperate Times
english.objective: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
english.complete: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.
english.detail:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.

english.title: Disrupting Logistics
english.objective: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

english.title: Disrupting Logistics
english.objective: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.complete: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.
english.detail:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

english.title: The Turncoat
english.objective: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
english.detail:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

english.title: The Turncoat
english.objective: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
english.complete: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>

There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

english.title: Unfortunate News
english.objective: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.detail: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

english.title: Unfortunate News
english.objective: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.progress: You are back? And... alone?
english.complete:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...
english.detail: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

english.title: Breaking the Breaker
english.objective: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, <Class>.

english.title: Breaking the Breaker
english.objective: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.complete:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, <class>. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.
english.detail:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, <class>.

english.title: Confront Lorthuna
english.objective: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.detail:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <Class>.

english.title: Confront Lorthuna
english.objective: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.complete:
I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.

Muln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.
english.detail:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.

english.title: Blood Tithe
english.objective: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
english.detail:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.

english.title: Blood Tithe
english.objective: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
english.progress: What? Alvarion is alive?
english.complete:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
english.detail:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
