english.title: Make Yourself Useful
english.objective: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
english.progress: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
english.complete: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
english.detail:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.

sixty.error: <urlopen error _ssl.c:1018: The handshake operation timed out>

english.title: Flutterfly Dust
english.objective: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.progress: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
english.complete:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
english.detail:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.

english.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
english.objective: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

english.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
english.objective: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.progress: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
english.complete: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
english.detail:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

english.title: The Hills Have Eyes
english.objective: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.

english.title: The Hills Have Eyes
english.objective: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.progress:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
english.complete:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
english.detail:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.

english.title: Standing Our Ground
english.objective: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
english.progress: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
english.complete: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.
english.detail:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

english.title: What Is My Purpose?
english.objective: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
english.detail:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>

english.title: What Is My Purpose?
english.objective: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
english.complete:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.
english.detail:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>

english.title: The Supreme Magister
english.objective: Find Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
english.complete:
Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.

With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid The High Order?

I suppose we will see.
english.detail:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

english.title: The Grand Skyseer
english.objective: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

english.title: The Grand Skyseer
english.objective: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
english.complete:
Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.

You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.

I look forward to further making your acquaintance.
english.detail:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

english.title: To Valanaar
english.objective: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.detail:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <Name>.

english.title: To Valanaar
english.objective: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.progress: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
english.complete:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
english.detail:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.

english.title: Deliver the News
english.objective: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
english.detail:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, <Name>. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

english.title: Deliver the News
english.objective: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
english.complete:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, <name>. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
english.detail:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, <name>. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

english.title: WANTED: Bruuz
english.objective: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
english.detail:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe

english.title: WANTED: Bruuz
english.objective: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
english.progress: What can I do for ya, <race>?
english.complete:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!" all the time?

I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
english.detail:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe

english.title: A Grand Adventure
english.objective: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
english.detail:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

english.title: A Grand Adventure
english.objective: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
english.complete:
So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.

Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?
english.detail:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

english.title: A Grand Adventure
english.objective: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
english.detail: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.

english.title: A Grand Adventure
english.objective: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
english.complete:
So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.

Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.

While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.
english.detail: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.

english.title: The Missing Scholar
english.objective: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
english.detail:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.

english.title: The Missing Scholar
english.objective: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
english.complete: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain you also notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>

english.title: Unwelcome Visitors
english.objective: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.
english.progress: The High Order does not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
english.complete:
That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!

Thank you for your service to the High Order, <class>.
english.detail:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.

english.title: Explosive Consultation
english.objective: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
english.detail:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.

english.title: Explosive Consultation
english.objective: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
english.complete: Need something blown up?
english.detail:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.

english.title: A Dynamite Plan
english.objective: Obtain 10 Rough Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
english.detail:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...

english.title: A Dynamite Plan
english.objective: Obtain 10 Rough Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
english.progress: Show me those explosives, <name>!
english.complete: This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... and add a little extra zing...
english.detail:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...

english.title: Detonation at a Distance
english.objective: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
english.complete: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?
english.detail:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.

english.title: Detonation at a Distance
english.objective: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
english.detail:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.

If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.

Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.

english.title: Detonation at a Distance
english.objective: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
english.progress: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
english.complete: Great--that's exactly what we need!
english.detail:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.

If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.

Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.

english.title: Explosive Consultation
english.objective: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
english.detail: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.

english.title: Explosive Consultation
english.objective: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
english.progress: Were your efforts in Stormwind fruitful?
english.complete: I'm glad you've returned, <name>.
english.detail: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.

english.title: Destruction in Deadmines
english.objective: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
english.detail:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.

english.title: Destruction in Deadmines
english.objective: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
english.complete: So you found the forge, and planted the bomb... only one thing remains to be done.
english.detail:

english.title: Destruction in Deadmines
english.objective: Use the detonator.
english.detail: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

english.title: Destruction in Deadmines
english.objective: Use the detonator.
english.complete: I don't know what to say, <name>. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...
english.detail: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

english.title: Avenged Tenfold
english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

english.title: Avenged Tenfold
english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
english.progress: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
english.complete:
The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.

<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>

...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.
english.detail:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.

english.title: Catching Wind
english.objective: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
english.detail:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.

english.title: Catching Wind
english.objective: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
english.progress:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
english.complete:
It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.

Unfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.

<name>, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.
english.detail:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.

english.title: The Missing Scholar
english.objective: Keep searching for Fillion Flamebreeze.
english.detail: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

english.title: The Missing Scholar
english.objective: Keep searching for Fillion Flamebreeze.
english.complete:
Th... thank you, stranger. I was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when I was suddenly ambushed and attacked by Windshapers. They forced me over to the mouth of the cave and left me there, barely conscious and bleeding. The last thing I remember before blacking out is a massive winged beast emerging from the cave and scooping me up.

I think it's safe to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its younglings.
english.detail: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

english.title: The Missing Scholar
english.objective: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.
english.detail:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.

english.title: The Missing Scholar
english.objective: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.
english.progress: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
english.complete: Thank you again, <name>.

english.title: In Service of Zephras
english.objective: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
english.detail:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

english.title: In Service of Zephras
english.objective: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
english.complete:
I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.

You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

english.title: In Service of Zephras
english.objective: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
english.detail:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

english.title: Return to Valanaar
english.objective: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.detail:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, <Class>.

english.objective: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
english.complete:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.

english.title: The High Elder's Request
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.detail:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

english.title: The High Elder's Request
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.complete: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.

english.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
english.objective: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
english.detail:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?

english.objective: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
english.progress: It's a mess out there, <name>! Did you collect the parts I need?
english.complete: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!

I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?

english.title: Making Our Move
english.objective: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, <Class>.

english.progress: <Hyusaa nods at you.>
english.complete: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.

english.title: Infiltrating the Cult
english.objective: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
english.detail:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.

english.title: Infiltrating the Cult
english.objective: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
english.complete:
Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?

There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.

english.title: Prepare for Battle
english.objective: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

english.title: Prepare for Battle
english.objective: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.complete: We are as ready as we'll ever be.

english.title: What Comes Next
english.objective: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
english.detail:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, <Name>.

english.title: What Comes Next
english.objective: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
english.complete:
It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Ansirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for our vanguard to depart.

english.objective: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

Winds be with you, <Name>.

english.complete:
I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.

english.title: The Strange Hermit
english.objective: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
english.detail:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

english.title: The Strange Hermit
english.objective: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
english.progress: So that's the story...
english.complete:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.

So er, um... how is your day going?

english.title: The Forest's Bounty
english.objective: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!

english.title: The Forest's Bounty
english.objective: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
english.complete:
Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted! 

Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.

english.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
english.objective: Collect 5 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

english.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
english.objective: Collect 5 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
english.progress: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
english.complete:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.

english.title: Free the Hollows
english.objective: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?

english.title: Free the Hollows
english.objective: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: We can only hope that those poor spirits are able to find peace after being freed from this place.
english.complete: Thank you, stranger.

english.title: Crab Season
english.objective: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
english.detail:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!

english.title: Crab Season
english.objective: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
english.progress:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
english.complete:
Winds bless me this meat looks fantastic! 

Thank you so much, <class>.

english.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
english.objective: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
english.detail:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

english.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
english.objective: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
english.progress: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.
english.complete: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

english.title: Pilfered Windstones
english.objective: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

english.title: Pilfered Windstones
english.objective: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress:
These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village. 

With the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.
english.complete: Thanks <class>. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.

english.title: Tower Defense
english.objective: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

english.title: Tower Defense
english.objective: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.complete: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.
english.detail:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.

english.title: More Al'Aketh Ears
english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that. 

Many among us are afraid.

I come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

english.title: More Al'Aketh Ears
english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: <Vayn nods at you.>
english.complete: As promised, here is your reward.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that. 

Many among us are afraid.

I come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

english.title: The Broken Construct
english.objective: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
english.detail:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

english.title: The Broken Construct
english.objective: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
english.complete:
<Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>

Storms curse where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!
english.detail:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

english.title: Unwelcome Spirits
english.objective: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.

english.title: Unwelcome Spirits
english.objective: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous place. Some even say its haunted. I'm quite sure that I don't believe that, but I do know that its not for the faint hearted, or the unprepared.
english.complete:
Handling these essences fills me with a sense of... deep disquiet. I can almost feel a malevolent, regretful aura emanating from them. It's enough to make me faint.

<Endaria shudders slightly.>

I do not look forward to studying these further.
english.detail:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.

english.title: The Broken Construct
english.objective: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
english.progress: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.
english.complete:
Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get. 

With these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.
english.detail:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

english.title: The Broken Construct
english.objective: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.

english.title: The Broken Construct
english.objective: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
english.complete:
Very interesting, so it was the High Order that was responsible for the construct breaking down?

I know Belathaan. He's Valennia Stormfist's cousin and his mother was actually a Windshaper. It's disappointing that he was involved in this.

I need to reflect on this for a moment.
english.detail:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.

english.title: Blood for Blood
english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.

english.title: Blood for Blood
english.objective: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.progress: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.
english.complete:
<Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.>

Don't mind me, <name>. Today has merely been... a trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.
english.detail:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.

english.title: A Firm Response
english.objective: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

english.title: A Firm Response
english.objective: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
english.complete:
Wait--what?! Belathaan... is dead? 

<Ayessa listens as you give your account of what occurred.> 

The High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?

Pay this no mind, <name>. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.
english.detail:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

english.title: Speak with Belann
english.objective: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
english.detail:
<Name>, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.

english.title: Speak with Belann
english.objective: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
english.complete: Ah, you must be <name>? It is heartening to see young mages eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.
english.detail:
<name>, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.

english.title: Boughs in the Wind
english.objective: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
english.detail:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.

english.title: Boughs in the Wind
english.objective: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
english.progress:
Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic. 

I am glad to see young mages such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.
english.complete:
Thank you, <name>. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.

Did this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the <class>, and not the other way around.

english.title: Confront Lorthuna
english.objective: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.detail:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <Class>.

english.title: Confront Lorthuna
english.objective: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.complete:
I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.
english.detail:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.

english.title: The Fate of Zephras
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.complete:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
english.detail:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

english.title: The Western Watch
english.objective: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
english.detail:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

english.title: The Western Watch
english.objective: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
english.complete: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>
english.detail:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

english.title: A Last Request
english.objective: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
english.detail: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

english.title: A Last Request
english.objective: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
english.progress: What news from the western watch?
english.complete:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse on these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
english.detail: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>

english.title: Of Mice and Milk
english.objective: Get the mouse a cookie.
english.detail:
I need a cookie, see? 

Nyeah!

english.title: Of Mice and Milk
english.objective: Get the mouse a cookie.
english.complete: (PH) Thanks!
english.detail:
I need a cookie, see? 

Nyeah!

english.title: Deliver the Signet
english.objective: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

english.title: Deliver the Signet
english.objective: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.progress: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.
english.complete:
I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.
english.detail:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.

english.title: Bugged
english.objective: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
english.detail:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

english.title: Bugged
english.objective: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
english.complete: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.
english.detail:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

english.title: A Little Beauty
english.objective: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: What beautiful things did you bring me?
english.complete:
It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. 

If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
english.detail:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

english.title: The Inner Sanctum
english.objective: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

english.title: The Inner Sanctum
english.objective: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
english.complete: <Valennia looks gravely wounded.>
english.detail:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

english.title: Exploring the Alliance
english.objective: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
english.detail:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.

english.title: Exploring the Alliance
english.objective: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
english.complete:
Ah, you are back.

I hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.

While you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.
english.detail:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
