english.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark
english.objective: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
english.progress: <Seena nods curtly at you.>
english.complete:
You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach out the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense.

Also, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me.

Banu'Adoraah, friend.
english.detail:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.

sixty.error: <urlopen error _ssl.c:1018: The handshake operation timed out>

english.title: The Great Ursera Spirit
english.objective: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
english.complete: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.
english.detail:
Greetings, <name>. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.complete: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.
english.detail:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.progress: You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
english.complete:
Excellent, <name>! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the <class> that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
english.detail:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.

english.title: Training the Beast
english.objective: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young <Class>.

english.title: Training the Beast
english.objective: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.complete:
A fledgling <class>, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, <name>, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
english.detail:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young <class>.

english.title: The Fate of Zephras
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

english.title: The Fate of Zephras
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
english.complete:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
english.detail:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
english.detail:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself.. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path. 

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of their necklaces they wear--crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
english.progress:
Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true <race>. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
english.complete:
Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now--accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
english.detail:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
english.detail:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <Name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.

english.title: Call of Earth
english.objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
english.progress: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
english.complete: Well done! Know this--totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
english.detail:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.

english.title: Meddlesome Mages
english.objective: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

english.title: Meddlesome Mages
english.objective: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: Do what must be done, <class>.
english.complete:
Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.
english.detail:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

english.title: The Anchors of Zephras
english.objective: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
english.progress:
My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.

Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
english.complete: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
english.detail:
Greetings, young <name>. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
english.detail:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
english.complete: You... you are a <class>? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!
english.detail:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.

sixty.error: <urlopen error _ssl.c:1018: The handshake operation timed out>

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
english.progress: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly <class>.
english.complete: This is very kind of you, <class>. Very kind indeed.
english.detail:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
english.detail: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, <Class>.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
english.complete:
You have done well, <name>. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light.

The Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again.

Take this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.
english.detail: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, <class>.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
english.detail:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
english.complete: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
english.complete:
So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... well, resorting to asking paladins for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance.

Please, help me.
english.detail:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
english.detail:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
english.complete: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
english.complete:
I'm... back? And saved by a <class> no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.

If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more that you can do to help the Forsaken.
english.detail:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
english.detail:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
english.progress: What news of Deathguard Falgan?
english.complete:
Thank you for saving my friend, <name>. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.

I know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but it's clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.
english.detail:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.

sixty.error: <urlopen error _ssl.c:1018: The handshake operation timed out>

english.title: A Lesson in Divinity
english.objective: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.
english.complete:
The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a <class> who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.

You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Bandarion Keep. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, <name>.
english.detail:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Bandarion Keep performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, <name>.

english.title: Unnerving Silence
english.objective: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
A moment if you will, <Name>. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

english.title: Unnerving Silence
english.objective: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
english.complete:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
english.detail:
A moment if you will, <name>. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

english.title: Tears of the Lady
english.objective: Collect 8 Lady's Tear Moss.
english.detail:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

english.title: Tears of the Lady
english.objective: Collect 8 Lady's Tear Moss.
english.progress: Have you found the Lady's Tear?
english.complete:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, <name>, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
english.detail:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.

english.title: Feathers for Binding
english.objective: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

english.title: Feathers for Binding
english.objective: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
english.complete: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
english.detail:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.

english.title: Unwanted and Unworthy
english.objective: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

english.title: Unwanted and Unworthy
english.objective: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.
english.complete:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, <class>.

I will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

english.title: The Ties That Bind
english.objective: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

english.title: The Ties That Bind
english.objective: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
english.complete:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, <name>. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.
english.detail:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.

english.title: The Wounds of Betrayal
english.objective: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.

english.title: The Wounds of Betrayal
english.objective: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
english.progress: <class>! You have returned. Were you able to reach my brothers and sisters? Did you find Jorel?
english.complete:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob and grits her teeth, letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'Aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
english.detail:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.

english.title: Ripped Missive
english.objective: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

english.title: Ripped Missive
english.objective: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
english.complete:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
english.detail: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>

english.title: The Fate of the Den
english.objective: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
english.detail:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, <Name>. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

english.title: The Fate of the Den
english.objective: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
english.complete:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>

I--I'm sorry, <name>. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows' sacrifice be in vain.

Please go swiftly, <name>. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

english.title: A Sacrifice in Vain
english.objective: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
english.detail:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

english.title: A Sacrifice in Vain
english.objective: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
english.complete:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain.

Please, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.
english.detail:

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

english.title: The Cult's True Plans
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
english.detail:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

english.title: The Cult's True Plans
english.objective: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
english.progress: That turncoat risked everything to escape the cult and bring us this crystal...
english.complete:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.
english.detail:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

english.title: Strength and Mercy
english.objective: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.

english.title: Strength and Mercy
english.objective: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.
english.complete:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, <class>. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.detail:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
english.progress: You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
english.complete: Excellent, <name>! You are quite a fast learner.

Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.

english.title: Training the Beast
english.detail:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young <Class>.

english.title: Training the Beast
english.objective: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.
english.complete:
A fledgling <class>, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, <name>, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
english.detail:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young <class>.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.detail:
You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
english.progress: With learning, <name>, comes mastery.
english.complete: Well done, <name>! You're quite in tune with the beast.
english.detail:
You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.detail:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion. 

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
english.progress: Go forth, <name>, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
english.complete: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, <name>!

english.title: Aid For The Refugees
english.objective: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
english.progress: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
english.complete: Thank you, <class>, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
english.detail:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.

94897.en: The Fate of a Loved One

english.title: The Fate of a Loved One
english.objective: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
english.detail:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

english.title: The Fate of a Loved One
english.objective: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
english.progress: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, <class>, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
english.complete:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, <class>. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
english.detail:

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.

english.title: The Magical City of Dalaran
english.objective: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
english.detail:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

english.title: The Magical City of Dalaran
english.objective: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
english.complete:
Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.  

As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

english.title: Welcome to Azeroth
english.objective: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
english.detail:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

english.title: Welcome to Azeroth
english.objective: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
english.complete:
Well met, <class>. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.

english.objective:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

english.complete: Well tamed, <name>! You are becoming adept already.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.

english.title: Taming the Beast
english.objective:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
english.detail:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.

Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands.

english.progress: You will learn, <name>, and one day you will be a great <class>.
english.complete: You're back already! Impressive speed, <name>!

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.

english.title: Never Saddle on Quality
english.objective: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
english.detail:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!

english.title: Never Saddle on Quality
english.objective: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
english.progress: You look chilly, <class>. How goes the hunt?
english.complete: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, <class>!
english.detail:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!

english.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
english.objective: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
english.detail:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.

english.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
english.objective: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
english.progress: I trust you did not get lost?
english.complete:
You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...

...but enough of superstition and rumors, <name>. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.

english.title: Whispering Horror Residue
english.objective: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
english.progress: Do you have something for me, <class>?
english.complete:
What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.

I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, <class>. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
english.detail: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.

english.title: The Earthen Ring
english.objective: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
english.detail:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, <Name>.

english.title: The Earthen Ring
english.objective: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
english.complete:
More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

english.title: Welcome to Azeroth
english.objective: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
english.complete:
Lok-tar, <class>. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.

An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the Horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.

You have my blessing to travel through Horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.
english.detail:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, <name>.

english.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides
english.objective: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
english.detail:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.

english.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides
english.objective: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
english.progress: How goes the hunt?
english.complete:
Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade. 

I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.
english.detail:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.

english.title: The Hermit Tanner
english.detail:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

english.title: The Hermit Tanner
english.objective: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
english.progress: Greetings, <class>. What brings you up to my property today?
english.complete: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
english.detail:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

english.title: Vrang's Game
english.objective: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
english.detail:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.

english.title: Vrang's Game
english.objective: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
english.progress: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
english.complete: Thank you for your aid, <class>. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.

While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

english.title: Unwelcome Guests
english.objective: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
english.complete:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, <class>.
english.detail:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

english.title: Trouble in the Valley
english.objective: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
english.progress:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
english.complete: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
english.detail:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

english.title: Her Name Is Olgra
english.objective: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
english.progress: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
english.complete:
I will place these adornments with Olgra's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge from this day until my last day. Each swing of my blade and enemy felled will be in her name.

You have done me... done us... a great honor. 

Lok-tar, <name>.
english.detail:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.

english.title: A Token of Good Faith
english.objective: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
english.detail:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.

english.title: A Token of Good Faith
english.objective: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
english.progress: Why are you addressing me, <class>?
english.complete:
I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.

There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

We will be watching.

english.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
english.objective: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!
english.progress: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
english.complete: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
english.detail:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!

english.title: Watching the Roads
english.objective: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
english.detail:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.

english.title: Watching the Roads
english.objective: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
english.complete:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.
english.detail:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

english.title: The Great Outdoors
english.objective: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
english.detail:
Well howdy there, <Class>. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.

english.title: The Great Outdoors
english.objective: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
english.progress: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
english.complete: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

english.title: Chakuyak
english.objective: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
english.progress: Have you found the big wolf?
english.complete: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
english.detail:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.

english.title: Camping 101: Cooking
english.objective: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
english.progress: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
english.complete:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
english.detail:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

english.detail:
<Name>, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

english.complete:

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

english.title: Legging It
english.objective: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
english.detail:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

english.title: Legging It
english.objective: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
english.complete: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, <name>. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
english.detail:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

english.title: For Honor
english.objective: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
english.detail:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.

english.title: For Honor
english.objective: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
english.progress: Have you done what I asked?
english.complete: These warriors will always be remembered, <name>. You have made sure of that.
english.detail:

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.

english.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
english.objective: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
english.detail:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!

english.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
english.objective: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
english.progress: Did you find the fruits?
english.complete: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!

Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

english.title: A Pain in the Neck
english.objective: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
english.detail:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!

english.progress: What do you have for me, <name>?
english.complete: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.

english.title: This Is Spinal Axe
english.objective: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
english.detail:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.

english.title: This Is Spinal Axe
english.objective: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete: These spines are tougher than I expected, <name>! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... but I'll keep working on it!

english.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
english.objective: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
english.detail:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, <Class>. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!

english.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
english.objective: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.

english.title: Ukor's Lost Pack
english.detail: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.

english.title: Ukor's Lost Pack
english.objective: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
english.progress: Something need doing?
english.complete: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
english.detail: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.

english.title: Halikor's Hoof
english.detail: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.

english.title: Halikor's Hoof
english.objective: Deliver Halikor's Hoof to Orgrimmar.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete: What a trophy, <class>! That must have been some fight!
english.detail: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.

english.title: The Argent Emissary
english.objective: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
english.detail:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

english.title: The Argent Emissary
english.objective: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
english.complete: Stay low and try not to be seen, <class>. These cultists are not to be trifled with.

english.title: A Righteous Cause
english.objective: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
english.detail:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

english.title: A Righteous Cause
english.objective: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
english.complete: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.

english.title: The Cult of the Damned
english.objective: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
english.detail: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

english.title: The Cult of the Damned
english.objective: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
english.progress: I have a special disgust for living servants of the Scourge. They have the free will to walk away, yet the promise of power and immortality has robbed them of their reason and their morality.
english.complete: Thank you for your aid, <class>. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
english.detail: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

english.title: Remnants of War
english.objective: Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
english.detail:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.

english.title: Remnants of War
english.objective: Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
english.progress: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
english.complete: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

english.title: Bandarion Keep
english.objective: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
english.detail:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

english.title: Bandarion Keep
english.objective: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
english.complete:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the Scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.

english.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch
english.objective: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
english.detail:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.

english.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch
english.objective: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
english.progress:
The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.

Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.

Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
english.complete: Thank you, <name>. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
